title: simplicio.executor-contract/v1
description: VENDORED COPY (issue #164). This is a local, hand-maintained copy of the 6-layer execute/deterministic_edit contract record produced by simplicio-dev-cli (see simplicio-dev-cli AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md 6-layer contract). It is NOT imported live from the simplicio-dev-cli repository -- true cross-repo schema import is not practical from this sandbox. simplicio-dev-cli is the source of truth; when its executor contract payload shape changes, update this file to match and bump the version directory (v1 -> v2) if the change is breaking. See ../README.md for the sync convention.
